name: flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
description: A canvas backdrop of small squares scattered on black where each square changes its opacity at random, so the field flickers like distant static.
use: A dark section wants a living, faintly digital texture behind a short message.
avoid: Dense text: the constant random blinking is distracting beside small type.
a11y: The canvas is decorative with no text alternative, and the constant flicker ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black stage filled with a loose grid of small pale squares at varying opacity, densest near the middle and fading toward the edges. A rounded dark card with a heading and caption sits in the centre.
behaves: Squares randomly switch their opacity many times a second, so patches of the grid blink brighter and dimmer while the overall field holds its place.
customise: Square size, gap, flicker chance, colour, max opacity and explicit width or height are props; the fade mask comes from a class.
weight: heavy: A requestAnimationFrame loop redraws thousands of canvas squares every frame.
